mapper.insert: INSERT INTO defense_answers (defense_id, question_id, sq_id, student_answer, score, feedback, created_at) VALUES (#{defenseId}, #{questionId}, #{sqId}, #{studentAnswer}, #{score}, #{feedback}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: update defense_records set feedback = #{feedback}, video_analysis = #{videoAnalysis}, report_analysis = #{reportAnalysis}, score = #{score}, updated_at = NOW() where defense_id = #{defenseId} and user_id = #{userId}
